exercises.title: Foods in the pictures (Ex. 1)
exercises.instruction: Find the foods in the pictures 1–8.

items.explanation: curry and rice — cà ri ăn với cơm.
cereal — ngũ cốc ăn sáng (thường ăn với sữa).
mashed potato — khoai tây nghiền.
fish and chips — cá tẩm bột chiên và khoai tây chiên (món Anh).
noodles, vegetables and chicken — mì xào rau và gà.
chicken and salad — gà và rau trộn.
toast — bánh mì nướng lát.
burger — bánh hamburger.

exercises.title: Countable or uncountable? (Ex. 1)
exercises.instruction: Put the food words into the correct column: countable or uncountable.

items.explanation: a burger, two burgers → đếm được.
cereal (ngũ cốc) nói chung → không đếm được.
chips (từng miếng khoai chiên) có -s → đếm được.
curry (món cà ri) → không đếm được.
fish là món ăn (thịt cá) → không đếm được.
mashed potato (khoai nghiền) là khối → không đếm được.
chicken là thịt gà (món ăn) → không đếm được.
a noodle, noodles → đếm được.
rice → không đếm được.
salad (rau trộn nói chung) → không đếm được.
toast (bánh mì nướng) → không đếm được (a slice of toast).
a vegetable, vegetables → đếm được.

exercises.title: Questions and evidence (Ex. 5)
exercises.instruction: Match questions 1–6 with the evidence a–f from the text.

items.left: Who realised that some people eat the same dishes for different meals?
items.right: But when I travelled in Asia, I realised that in many places, there is no difference between breakfast and dinner
items.explanation: Aileen (E): no difference between breakfast and dinner = eat the same dishes for different meals.

items.right: I can't believe there are people in the world who live on 'junk food'
items.explanation: Alfredo (B): fast food/junk food ↔ takeaway culture.

items.left: Who discusses travelling for people on a special diet?
items.right: … we forget that not everyone in the world understands vegetarianism.
items.explanation: Pauline (D): vegetarian/vegan = special diet.

items.left: Who talks about what is considered polite in different cultures?
items.right: In China, when we are offered something, we say 'No thanks' … In other countries, though, 'no' means 'no'
items.explanation: Qiang Shi (C).

items.left: Who found it difficult to learn a new way of eating?
items.right: I thought I knew where my mouth was, but my first few attempts were a disaster.
items.explanation: Charles (A): ăn bốc lần đầu thất bại.

items.left: Who talks about producing your own food?
items.right: A lot of people grow their own vegetables and keep chickens.
items.explanation: Alfredo (B): grow vegetables, keep chickens = producing your own food.

exercises.title: Correct the errors (Ex. 7)
exercises.instruction: Correct the errors in these sentences.

items.prompt: Fresh fruit are healthy and we should eat them every day.
items.answer: Fresh fruit is healthy and we should eat it every day.
items.explanation: fruit không đếm được → is, it.

items.prompt: Chips cooked in the oven is healthier than fried chips.
items.answer: Chips cooked in the oven are healthier than fried chips.
items.explanation: chips số nhiều → are.

items.prompt: The burgers and the pizza are the cheapest foods you can buy.
items.answer: Burgers and pizza are the cheapest foods you can buy.
items.explanation: Nói chung chung → bỏ the.

items.prompt: In the India it is easy to find the vegetarian food.
items.answer: In India it is easy to find vegetarian food.
items.explanation: Tên nước không dùng the; vegetarian food nói chung → bỏ the.
Thịt gà (món ăn) không đếm được.

exercises.title: some, any, much or many? (Ex. 8)
exercises.instruction: Complete the sentences with some, any, much or many.

items.prompt: There are ____ mushrooms in the fridge.
items.explanation: Câu khẳng định + mushrooms số nhiều → some.

items.prompt: Are ____ people vegetarian in your country?
items.explanation: Câu hỏi + people (số nhiều, đếm được) → many.

items.prompt: I don't put ____ sugar in my tea – just half a spoonful.
items.explanation: Phủ định + sugar không đếm được → much.
Câu hỏi + flour không đếm được → any (hoặc much).

items.prompt: Can I have ____ more cake, please?
items.explanation: Lời đề nghị/yêu cầu → some.

items.prompt: How ____ rice do you eat every week?
items.explanation: rice không đếm được → How much?

exercises.title: Ways of preparing food (Ex. 1)
exercises.instruction: Label the different ways of preparing food with verbs from the box: bake, boil, fry, grill.

items.explanation: boil — luộc trong nước sôi.
fry — chiên trong chảo dầu.
bake — nướng trong lò (bánh mì, bánh ngọt).
grill — nướng vỉ (nhiệt trực tiếp từ trên/dưới).

exercises.title: Types of food (Ex. 2)
exercises.instruction: Match the words with the type of food they are.

items.explanation: beef — thịt bò → món thịt.
steak — bít tết → món thịt.
burger — bánh kẹp thịt → món thịt.
lamb — thịt cừu → món thịt.
potatoes — khoai tây → rau củ.
carrots — cà rốt → rau củ.
cucumbers — dưa chuột → rau củ.
peas — đậu Hà Lan → rau củ.
apples — táo → trái cây.
strawberries — dâu tây → trái cây.
pears — lê → trái cây.
bananas — chuối → trái cây.
biscuits — bánh quy → đồ ngọt.
cake — bánh ngọt → đồ ngọt.
chocolate — sô-cô-la → đồ ngọt.
pastries — bánh ngọt nướng (bánh sừng bò…) → đồ ngọt.

exercises.title: Words in the script (Ex. 8)
exercises.instruction: Find words in the Listening script of exercise 6 that mean the following.

items.explanation: crowded (đông đúc) ≈ busy.
delicious (ngon) ≈ tasty.
cheap (rẻ) ≈ low-cost.
smart (sang trọng) ≈ fashionable.
inexpensive (không đắt) ≈ reasonable (giá phải chăng).

exercises.title: Synonym and paraphrase (Ex. 9)
exercises.instruction: Choose the option, A, B or C, which does NOT mean the same as the first sentence.

items.prompt: The price of food in the restaurant is cheap.

options.text: The price of a meal in the restaurant is reasonable.
The restaurant is excellent if you want a budget meal.
The food in the restaurant is overpriced.

items.explanation: overpriced = quá đắt (ngược với cheap).

items.prompt: Marco cooked us a really tasty meal.

options.text: The meal Marco prepared was delicious.
Marco cooked us a really unappetising meal.
The meal Marco made for us was mouth-watering.

items.explanation: unappetising = không ngon miệng.

items.prompt: We were served food that was cooked in the old-fashioned way.

options.text: The meal we had was very contemporary in style.
The meal we had was very traditional.
The meal was made from a historic recipe.

items.explanation: contemporary = hiện đại (ngược với old-fashioned).

items.prompt: When I went to Thailand, I really enjoyed trying the street food.

options.text: I really liked tasting the food that was sold outdoors in Thailand.
In Thailand I loved the food we bought from stalls in the streets.
I enjoyed eating at restaurants when I was in Thailand.

items.explanation: restaurants ≠ street food.

items.prompt: The chef at the Lodge Hotel is very skilful.

options.text: The chef at the Lodge Hotel is bad at his job.
The chef at the Lodge Hotel has a lot of expertise.
The chef at the Lodge Hotel is highly trained.

items.explanation: skilful = khéo léo, giỏi nghề; A nói đầu bếp làm dở → KHÔNG cùng nghĩa.

items.prompt: The ingredients for the recipe can be changed to ones you have available.

options.text: You can use different ingredients to make this dish if you can't find everything.
You can be flexible about what ingredients you add to this recipe.
You should follow the recipe strictly or it won't taste good.

items.explanation: strictly = nghiêm ngặt (ngược với can be changed).

items.prompt: The chef at the new restaurant is famous across the country.

options.text: The chef at the new restaurant is well known nationally.
The chef at the new restaurant is recognised across the country.
The chef at the new restaurant is unknown outside of his town.

items.explanation: famous across the country = nổi tiếng cả nước; C nói không ai biết ngoài thị trấn → ngược nghĩa.

items.prompt: I didn't like the soup; it was too spicy.

options.text: The soup had too much pepper.
The soup wasn't tasty.
The soup was a bit too hot for my taste.

items.explanation: "wasn't tasty" = không ngon — không nói đến cay.

exercises.title: Words that helped you (Ex. 10)
exercises.instruction: Match the words in the first sentences of exercise 9 with the words in the options that mean the same.

items.explanation: cheap ≈ reasonable, budget (giá phải chăng, bình dân).
tasty ≈ delicious, mouth-watering (ngon, thèm chảy nước miếng).
old-fashioned ≈ traditional, historic (kiểu xưa, truyền thống).

items.right: sold outdoors, from stalls in the streets
items.explanation: street food ≈ sold outdoors / from stalls in the streets (bán ngoài trời, ở quầy ven đường).
skilful ≈ expertise, highly trained (chuyên môn cao).
can be changed ≈ use different ingredients, flexible (linh hoạt).
famous ≈ well known, recognised (được biết đến).
too spicy ≈ too much pepper, too hot (quá cay).
